name: truth-first-host-handoff-stale-doc-guard-plan
title: Write the Truth-First Host Handoff stale-doc guard execution plan
description: Create an execution plan that prevents Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, or future hosts from treating stale plan/backfill documents as current truth after work is already completed. The plan must define truth-source priority, stale/superseded doc detection, dev-memory preflight consumption, host handoff facts, and acceptance criteria for implementation.
